The third chart illustrates 'Losses per $1,000 of Payroll', showing a decline from $18.20 in 1998 to $14.20 in 1999, $3.90 in 2003, and dropping to $0.30 in 2004, with no losses recorded in 2005, $0.70 in 2006, and $0.30 in 2007. The overall trend indicates a decrease in losses per $1,000 of payroll over the years, with the peak loss occurring in 1999 and the lowest loss recorded in 2005. The data spans from 1998 to 2007.
